name: cable face pull with external rotation
description: A face pull that finishes with a rotation of the arms. It hits the rear shoulders and rotator cuff for healthy shoulders.
instructions: Set a rope at upper chest height and hold it with both hands, arms extended.
Pull the rope toward your face with elbows high.
At the end, rotate your fists upward so your hands finish above your elbows.
Squeeze your rear shoulders for a second.
Reverse the rotation and return slowly.
